title: Length of the nested pair encoding
statement: For bit strings $b$, $\alpha$, and $x$, the nested pair encoding $\langle\langle b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ has length $4|b|+2|\alpha|+6+|x|$.
replaced:
For all bit strings $b$, $\alpha$, $x$, the nested pair encoding
$\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ has length
$4|b| + 2|\alpha| + 6 + |x|$.
